ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animals ENVIRONMENT.

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

6. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

7. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

8. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying : OUR SCHOOL? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for : OUR SCHOOL.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about : OUR SCHOOL.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on : OUR SCHOOL.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to : OUR SCHOOL.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Home ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Home ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Home ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Home ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Home ENVIRONMENT.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Foods/Feeding PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.

13. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hand washing PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hand washing PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hand washing PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hand washing PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Hand washing PRACTICES.

15. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

16. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for the teeth PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for the teeth PRACTICES.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Weather ENVIRONMENT.

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sanitation/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sanitation/ PRACTICES.

20. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants ENVIRONMENT.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Hand washing PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Care for the teeth PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
